verdict.rationale: Secureframe documents an in-platform risk register that can be seeded from a NIST risk library. Comply AI for Risk produces inherent risk scores, treatment, residual risk scores and justifications, and the MCP server exposes risks as manageable objects. Risk owners, recurring risk review cycles and risk-to-control linkage are not evidenced; the recurring reviews shown cover vendors and access, not risks. missing for 10: documented risk owners, risk review cycles/reminders, explicit mapping of risks to controls, independent or hands-on corroboration.
